specs.label: Ethernet
specs.value: 100/1000 Mbps, autoswitching, autonegotiating, autodiscovery, full/half duplex, industry-standard TCP/IP stack, UDP/IP, CIP, DHCP, SSL, TLS, SSH, SFTP (SSH File Transfer Protocol), FIPS 140-2 compliant encryption, IEEE 8

specs.label: Control Subnet
specs.value: 100/1000 Mbps Ethernet, autoswitching, autonegotiating, autodiscovery, full/half duplex, DHCP server, DNS server, port forwarding, isolation mode

specs.label: USB
specs.value: Supports USB mass storage class devices via the rear panel USB 2.0 host port, supports computer console via the front panel USB 2.0 device port

specs.label: IR/Serial
specs.value: Supports 1-way device control via infrared up to 1.2 MHz or serial TTL/RS-232 (0–5V) up to 115.2k baud

specs.label: Memory Card
specs.value: Supports SD and SDHC cards up to 32 GB

specs.label: External Storage
specs.value: Supports USB mass storage devices up to 1 TB
